captchaconsent-notice:
Warning shown above a CAPTCHA widget when the visitor has not accepted the cookie category the CAPTCHA needs.

Parameters:
* $1 - the name of the cookie category
captchaconsent-notice-link: Text of the link that opens the cookie preferences dialog.
captchaconsent-ve-notice:
Warning shown in the VisualEditor save flow when a CAPTCHA is required and the cookie category is not accepted.

Parameters:
* $1 - the name of the cookie category
